name: Fever
overview: Scripture presents fever both as a physical affliction and as a consequence of divine judgment, as seen in Leviticus 26:16 and Deuteronomy 28:22 where fever is linked to God's discipline upon disobedience. The Psalms and Job describe the debilitating effects of intense heat and fever on the human body, highlighting human frailty. In the New Testament, Jesus and the Apostle Paul demonstrate God's power to heal fevers, affirming His compassion and authority over sickness, as recorded in Matthew 8:14 and Acts 28:8.
